annotations.title: Get one hotel's full-stay rooms and prices

description: Returns one named or identified hotel's full-stay property data and live room offers for specified dates and occupancy. When the user refers to a hotel from a previous search_accommodations result by list position or partial name, copy its propertyId exactly if the match is unique; never shorten, combine, or use a placeholder ID. Ask for clarification if several hotels match. Use hotelName and optional destination when no exact propertyId is available. Includes wholesale room types and photos, breakfast, refundability, cancellation terms, public-rate comparisons, masked wholesale rate bands, and Brek links. Public-only room types are excluded. Wholesale options priced above their public comparison are marked sold_out without a price; the public comparison remains available. Single-room and multi-room stays are supported through aggregate occupancy plus optional per-room arrangements. Exact private wholesale prices are available on Brek.

adults.description: Whole-number total adult count from 1 to 16 across all rooms.

checkinDate.description: Required with checkoutDate unless the user explicitly requested tonight. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

checkoutDate.description: Required with checkinDate unless the user explicitly requested tonight. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

childrenAges.description: Whole-number ages from 0 to 17 for up to 8 children at check-in.

currency.description: Only specify a currency when the traveler explicitly requests one. Otherwise omit it so Brek can use the visitor country, then locale, then USD. Supported: EUR, USD, INR, GBP, AUD, CAD, ARS, TRY, COP, CLP, SEK, MXN, IDR, BRL.

dateIntent.description: Use only when the user explicitly requests tonight. Resolves check-in as the current local date and check-out as the following date; otherwise provide both stay dates.

destination.description: Optional city or region for disambiguating hotelName.

hotelName.description: Exact hotel name when propertyId is unavailable.

propertyId.description: Exact Brek property ID copied from a previous search result or Brek stay URL. Do not guess, truncate, combine, or pass a placeholder; use hotelName if unsure.

roomArrangements.description: Exact per-room occupancy. Example: room 1 has 2 adults and room 2 has 2 adults plus children ages 4 and 2 => [{adults:2,childrenAges:[],infants:0},{adults:2,childrenAges:[4,2],infants:0}]. Array length equals rooms, and aggregate guests equal adults and childrenAges.

adults.description: Whole-number adult count from 1 to 8 in this specific room.

childrenAges.description: Whole-number ages from 0 to 17 for up to 8 children staying in this room.

infants.description: Whole-number infant count from 0 to 4 in this room.

rooms.description: Whole-number room count from 1 to 3. Each room requires at least one adult.

timeZone.description: Optional IANA time-zone fallback for resolving relative stay dates; destination or property location takes precedence.

name: get_accommodation_offers

availability.description: Wholesale display availability. A wholesale rate higher than its public comparison is sold_out and has no price or booking action.
